$comment: What the Figma components actually BIND, as opposed to what variables exist.
Produced by figma/export-bindings.js. Checked by scripts/verify-bindings.mjs.
The exporter MUST use all three traversal rules or this file is a lie:
1. setCurrentPageAsync before reading - instance overrides are unreliable otherwise
2. walk .children recursively - findAll() skips hidden instance subtrees
3. reveal hidden instances first, repeatedly, then restore
Skipping any one of them once reported 407 live bindings as zero.
The Icons page (1,753 Lucide components, all icon/default) is excluded - it
would triple the file for one repeated fact.
